summary: The requirement document describes a maintenance system for two auto-component plants in Pune with 320 machines. Operators raise breakdowns by scanning QR codes, supervisors run work orders and preventive maintenance, technicians use an offline-capable Android app, and stores keep spare parts linked to SAP purchasing. It also asks for sensor readings with alerts, failure prediction for compressors, dashboards and two years of on-call support.

evidence.quote: Operators shall raise a breakdown request by scanning the QR code on the machine with a phone.

stories: As an operator, I can raise a breakdown request by scanning the QR code on the machine with a phone

evidence.quote: Technicians shall use an Android app to see and update their work orders, take photos and follow checklists.

unclear_points.why: The document does not say which SAP module or interface (API, IDoc, file) accepts the approved requests.
unclear_points.quote: approved requests shall be sent to SAP.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Regarding clause 3.8, please specify the SAP version and the interface (API, IDoc or file) through which approved purchase requests are to be sent, and whether SAP-side support will be provided.

unclear_points.why: The document does not say how many engineers are on call, their response times or whether anyone must be at the plant.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Regarding clause 5.1, please state the required response and resolution times for on-call support, the number of engineers expected on call, and whether any staff must be stationed at the plants.
